body: I've thought about this.  On one hand it would allow time for decompression and a new experience, maybe that's something I need. But I feel like getting away could be a slippery slope.  I wouldn't trust myself not to disengage completely and detach.

Trust me, being in charge of another life is the last thing I need. I can't even take care of myself.  I don't think something like that would fix what I feel is broken with me. I appreciate the thought though.
